mechanism: Rank today's implied vol against its trailing 252-day window (percentile bands 20/40/60/80 -> LOW..HIGH); regress forward 30-day mean IV on current IV and take the fixed point slope/intercept (IV* = b/(1-a)) as the mean-reversion level, with separate slopes above and below it; IV above ~80th percentile is read as 'expect reversion down', and IV persistently above realized vol as the variance risk premium.
causal_rationale: Implied vol embeds an insurance premium that is richest when fear is high, and vol is mean-reverting; the state therefore carries information about the forward path of realized vol and about drift (leverage effect) of the underlying.
original_universe: US single stocks / SPY via IBKR OPTION_IMPLIED_VOLATILITY bars
original_implementation: Tkinter dashboard; full-sample regression of forward IV on current IV (overlapping 30-day windows), percentile via rolling rank
weaknesses: Regression uses overlapping forward windows (serially correlated residuals, inflated R^2) and full-sample fit; the option leg it suggests (sell ATM straddles) is not tradable on MT5; donor's analyzer has a theta bug (adds put delta instead of put theta in one version).
mt5_translation: State/conditioning feature for the underlying CFD: IV percentile and IV - RV(broker bars) for ^VIX->US500/NAS100, ^VXN->NAS100, ^GVZ->XAUUSD, ^OVX->XTIUSD/XBRUSD. The desk already archives exactly this join; it needs a consumer (alt_conditioned / exogenous_conditioner gating, or the allocator's vol state).
pit_requirements: Use only vol_archive vintages (as-of snapshots) or next-session availability for public CBOE closes; percentile window strictly trailing.
feature_representation: iv_pct_252 in [0,1]; vrp = IV - RV20(broker H1, annualised); fixed point IV* re-estimated on an expanding window with non-overlapping 30-day targets.
hypothesis: For XAUUSD and US500, existing price-only cells gated off when the paired implied-vol percentile > 0.8 (or gated on, for mean-reversion cells) show a forward E[log W] difference versus ungated cells larger than the same gate built on a date-shuffled IV series.
entry_exit: Conditioner only: base family's own entries/exits.
leakage_risks: Overlapping forward windows; restated CBOE history instead of the as-of vintage; percentile computed over the full sample.
selection_risks: Many base cells x 4 IV series x bands = large trial count; route through alt_conditioned so the charge is counted once per cell.
falsifier: Gate effect indistinguishable from the shuffled-IV gate across the judged cells.
expected_orthogonality: High vs price-only volatility features if IV-RV carries premium information beyond RV; low if IV percentile is just a lagged RV percentile (test G).

control_matrix.C: IV pct + VRP sign, trailing windows, as-of vintages
control_matrix.F: random gate with matched open fraction
control_matrix.G: RV percentile of the CFD itself

mechanism: Before a scheduled event (earnings, PCE) option IV is inflated relative to the move that follows; short ATM straddle captures the IV collapse when the realised move is smaller than priced. Dashboard measures pre/post IV, straddle repricing, overnight gap and total move.
causal_rationale: Event uncertainty is systematically overpriced (insurance premium); after the print the uncertainty resolves and IV drops mechanically.
original_universe: US single stocks (NVDA, DELL, ZS) and their options
original_data: IBKR daily price, IV bars, VIX
original_implementation: Black-Scholes repricing of an ATM straddle with pre and post IV; post price = average of next-day open and close
weaknesses: Post price averages next-day open and close (look-ahead for any decision taken at the open); fallback IV from VIX*1.2 is invented; one-event anecdotes; the option trade itself is not available on MT5.
mt5_translation: Two state features in the news/earnings lane: (a) implied_move = pre-event straddle/spot, and (b) ratio realised_move/implied_move history per name or index. For share CFDs (event lane only) and indices, condition event_reaction fade/follow on whether the market historically over- or under-priced this event's move.
pit_requirements: Pre-event IV must be stamped before the release; earnings dates as first-known; realised move measured only after the release bar closes.
feature_representation: implied_move_pct, realised_over_implied (rolling mean over the last 8 events of the same name).
hypothesis: For share CFDs whose last-8-event realised/implied ratio < 0.8, fading the first post-earnings H1 move (event_reaction fade=True) has positive net expectancy, and the ratio sorts expectancy monotonically.
entry_exit: Event-lane: base event_reaction entry after react_bars=1; exit TTL 6-24 bars.
execution: Share CFDs trade only in cash hours; avoid the opening auction bar.
costs: Share CFD commission/spread; gap risk on the stop.
leakage_risks: Donor's open/close averaging; IV snapshots taken after the release; earnings-date revisions.
selection_risks: Single names chosen for being famous earnings movers.
baseline: event_reaction fade without the implied-move conditioner.
falsifier: No monotone relation between realised/implied history and post-event fade expectancy.

mechanism: Implied probabilities (Polymarket, betting odds, rate-cut pricing) measure how priced-in an outcome is; the market reaction to the realised outcome should scale with 1 - implied probability, so a 90%-priced rate cut moves price little and a surprise moves it a lot.
causal_rationale: Prices move on the unexpected component of news.
mt5_translation: For macro events with a prediction-market or futures-implied probability, define surprise_pm = outcome - p_implied (pre-event, first-seen) and condition event_reaction follow/fade on |surprise_pm| on FX/indices/gold.
pit_requirements: Implied probability snapshot strictly before the release; outcome resolution time.
hypothesis: For FOMC/CPI-type events, the absolute 1-hour reaction of USDJPY/XAUUSD/US500 is increasing in |outcome - p_implied|, and following the reaction when |surprise_pm| > 0.5 has positive net expectancy.
execution: Spread widens on release; enter after the first bar.
leakage_risks: Using the post-release market price as 'implied'.
selection_risks: Few events per year; pool across event kinds.
falsifier: No monotone relation between |surprise_pm| and reaction size.

mechanism: Stream broker-computed implied vols for the next six expiries and strikes within +-2% of spot, pivot to an expiry x strike surface (linear fill), and read the front-month skew and the ATM term structure. Skew and term slope are the market's price of crash risk and of near-term versus later uncertainty.
causal_rationale: Hedgers pay for downside protection; when demand for near-dated puts spikes, front skew steepens and the term structure inverts, which precedes or coincides with realised stress in the underlying.
original_data: IBKR option chain parameters + tickOptionComputation implied vol
original_implementation: Desktop live 3D surface + front-month skew plot; no signal.
weaknesses: Only +-2% strikes (no wings, so 'skew' is near-ATM slope); interpolation fills gaps silently; no archive, no PIT history; IBKR market data entitlement needed.
mt5_translation: Options do not trade on MT5. Use keyless public analogues as STATE features for the underlying CFD: VIX9D/VIX/VIX3M term slope and inversion flag, CBOE SKEW as a skew proxy for US500, GVZ for XAUUSD, OVX for XTIUSD, VXN for NAS100, as conditioners of existing price families.
pit_requirements: Use the desk's own hourly vintage (vol_archive observations) as of the decision bar, never the restated daily series.
hypothesis: US500 drawdown_conditional entries taken when VIX term structure is in contango (VIX3M > VIX) have higher net expectancy than those taken when it is inverted.
entry_exit: Conditioner on a base price family (e.g., drawdown_conditional, overnight_gap_decay).

falsifier: No expectancy difference between term-shape buckets in walk-forward on the archived vintages.
expected_orthogonality: Partly redundant with realised-vol state (H: regime_split vol axis).

mechanism: Fair variance-swap strike from log-contract replication: realised variance equals twice the hedged log payoff, and the log payoff is spanned by a 1/K^2-weighted strip of OTM puts and calls (Carr-Madan, Demeterfi-Derman-Kamal-Zou); the discrete strip is the VIX formula. Practitioner caveats: strike truncation biases it low, skew extrapolation is needed, jumps break the replication.
causal_rationale: Gives a model-free implied variance to compare with realised variance (the VRP, QG26-09).
weaknesses: Requires a full option chain; truncation and jump error.

mechanism: Implied vol exceeds subsequently realised vol on average (insurance premium); the donor regresses forward 30-day realised variance on today's implied variance and shows both 'selling insurance' and 'buying insurance' can be profitable depending on timing (crash states). The spread IV^2 - RV^2 and the regression residual are state variables: a wide premium is compensation available to a short-vol carrier; a collapsed or negative premium marks stress.
causal_rationale: Hedgers who cannot bear tails pay a premium to transfer them; the premium widens after shocks and compresses in complacent markets.
original_universe: SPX implied (30d) vs realised vol, 10 years
original_data: csv of SPX option-implied and realised vol
original_implementation: Plots, rolling expectation windows, scatter of IV vs forward RV with OLS line, toy insurance-seller vs insured equity simulation.
weaknesses: No out-of-sample test; the profitable seller curve is a stylised simulation; ignores that the trade needs options.
mt5_translation: State/conditioning feature for index, gold and oil CFDs: vrp = IV(index)^2 - RV(this broker's bars)^2 on matched horizons from vol_archive; use (a) as a conditioner on short-horizon reversion families (trade reversion when vrp rank is high: dealers long gamma, moves dampen), and (b) as a crash-state flag when vrp < 0.
pit_requirements: Implied from the desk's hourly vintage; RV from bars closed before the decision; forward RV never enters a feature.
feature_representation: vrp_level, vrp_rank_252, vrp_negative flag, forward-RV regression residual.
hypothesis: On US500/NAS100 H1, vol_mean_reversion and overnight_gap_decay entries taken when vrp_rank_252 >= 0.7 have higher net expectancy than entries when vrp_rank_252 <= 0.3; and vrp < 0 days have more negative 5-day forward returns than vrp > 0 days.
entry_exit: Conditioner on the base family; for the crash flag, a state passed to the allocator.
leakage_risks: Matching IV to RV computed over the FORWARD window (the regression target) is the classic leak.
selection_risks: Two markets with deep implied history (the census notes the class died on breadth); charge every family x bucket.
falsifier: Bucket expectancy difference not significant after the multiplicity charge on the archived vintage, or vanishes once realised-vol tercile is controlled.
expected_orthogonality: Partially overlaps realised-vol regime; the implied leg is information price data lacks.

mechanism: Discrete delta hedging of a European call: Black-Scholes price and delta recomputed each step as the underlying moves and time decays; the hedge error (option P&L minus delta x underlying P&L) is the state a dealer manages.
causal_rationale: A short-gamma dealer must buy into rallies and sell into declines to stay delta-neutral; aggregated, that rebalancing amplifies moves (negative dealer gamma) or dampens them (positive dealer gamma) near large open-interest strikes and into the close.

weaknesses: Visualiser, not a hedger: no hedge P&L is computed; wall-clock time to expiry; price shock unscaled by vol (QG-ADH-003).
mt5_translation: Options never trade. Dealer-gamma state (sign and size of aggregate dealer gamma near spot, from public OI) becomes a STATE feature for index and gold CFDs; existing price proxies (closing-hour displacement with elevated realised vol) are the H arm.

hypothesis: When estimated dealer gamma on SPY/QQQ is negative, US500/NAS100 rest-of-day displacement continues into the close more often than when it is positive.

mechanism: Backfill the released 'actual' of the highest-visibility releases (Fed funds target, ECB MRO and DFR, NFP change, unemployment, CPI and core CPI m/m and y/y) from FRED, accepting it only when FRED's own observation date matches the release's REFERENCE PERIOD (monthly) or the decision date (rates).
causal_rationale: Surprise = actual - consensus moves FX/indices/gold at release; the desk has consensus (Forex Factory) but documents that it lacks 'actual'.
original_data: nfs.faireconomy.media weekly JSON (forecast, previous) + fred.stlouisfed.org fredgraph.csv
original_implementation: regex title matcher -> FRED series; freshness by reference period
weaknesses: Uses FRED CURRENT vintage (PAYEMS/CPI get revised: first-print surprise needs ALFRED vintages); CPI y/y computed from SA CPIAUCSL while consensus is the NSA headline; NFP 'change' rounded from level differences of revised data.
mt5_translation: Register a FRED/ALFRED 'actual' half-row source in event_consensus_sources.json for the nine matchers (first-release vintage via ALFRED realtime_start), joined by the existing event_surprise.join_sides on reference period; feed event_reaction and the event-state surprise field.
pit_requirements: actual stamped at ALFRED realtime_start of the FIRST vintage (not today's value); pair stamped at the later of the two halves (event_surprise rule)
feature_representation: surprise_z = (actual_first - consensus) / rolling sd of past surprises
hypothesis: EURUSD H1 return in the release hour has the sign of -(US surprise_z) for NFP and CPI with hit rate > 55% over >= 100 releases, and the effect scales with |surprise_z|.
entry_exit: event_reaction on the release clock, follow (fade=False) when |z| > 1
execution: market at first bar after release; event-window spread distribution
costs: release-hour spreads (widened); slippage on the first bar
leakage_risks: current-vintage actuals (revisions) masquerading as first prints; FRED posting lag
falsifier: surprise-signed reaction no better than unsigned over >= 100 events
expected_orthogonality: high vs price families; this is the macro-surprise axis itself

mechanism: Free option chains (strike, bid/ask, volume, OI, IV) for US names and ETFs -> put/call OI and volume ratios, ATM IV, skew and dealer-gamma inputs for the ETF proxies of CFD underlyings (SPY, QQQ, IWM, GLD, SLV, USO, UNG, TLT, UUP, FXE, FXY).
causal_rationale: Options positioning and implied skew carry forward-looking information about tail demand and dealer hedging that bars do not.
original_implementation: display only; IV only from Yahoo
weaknesses: Snapshots, no history: an archive must be accumulated forward (no backtest until vintages exist).
mt5_translation: State features only (options never trade): ETF chain -> P/C OI ratio, 25d skew proxy, GEX sign, mapped GLD->XAUUSD, SPY->US500, QQQ->NAS100, IWM->US2000, USO->XTIUSD, UNG->XNGUSD, TLT->UST10Y, UUP->USDX, FXE->EURUSD, FXY->USDJPY.
pit_requirements: snapshot time recorded at fetch; OI is prior-day; forward-only archive
feature_representation: pc_oi_ratio, atm_iv, skew = IV(0.9S) - IV(1.1S) for front expiry, gex_sign
hypothesis: (forward-only) GLD front-month skew percentile predicts XAUUSD 5-day realised vol rank.
leakage_risks: OI date vs snapshot date; Yahoo crumb session failures returning partial chains
selection_risks: ETF proxy != CFD underlying (GLD vs spot gold timing)
falsifier: no incremental predictive power over VIX/GVZ/OVX levels after 250 forward observations
